datacite.title: Myexperiment Workflows, "Abstracted" (All Non-Analytical Nodes Removed)
datacite.abstract: To do the SCOFF analysis (detecting highly similar workflow fragments) we took all bioinformatics-related workflows from myExperiment and removed all non-analytical nodes.  These included nodes referred-to as "shims" - those that do data structure/type transformations, but not any "semantic" transformation.  This deposit contains all such abstracted workflows.
